Payout of 15 July is short ₹1,173.99.
The bank credited ₹2,66,673.63 against an expected ₹2,67,847.62. 31 orders sit in this payout. This is consistent with chargeback cb_00002 of ₹1,173.99, raised 29 July. The gateway debits a disputed amount when it receives the dispute, but books it against the cycle in which the dispute is later confirmed, so the two can fall in different payouts.
Suggested action: confirm chargeback cb_00002 against this payout and record the dispute in the books. The amounts match, which is not proof of cause -- cb_00002 is booked to another cycle, so the link is not confirmed.
